subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should OpenClaw make multi-agent completion delivery and session ownership durable/idempotent by default, or keep best-effort announce with narrower retry/diagnostic mitigations?
rationale: The remaining failures span session locks, subagent delivery durability, duplicate-send prevention, requester wakeup, completion payload isolation, and operator recovery; source review can prove the gaps but cannot choose the permanent product contract safely.

options.title: Define durable orchestration contract
options.body: Make subagent completion and inter-agent delivery idempotent, recoverable, and observable before treating the umbrella issue as solved.

options.title: Land narrow mitigations first
options.body: Review and land focused fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 while keeping this umbrella open for the broader contract.

options.title: Document best-effort behavior
options.body: Explicitly accept best-effort announce and close only after maintainers decide that durable delivery and recovery are out of scope for core.

recommendation.title: Define durable orchestration contract
recommendation.body: Make subagent completion and inter-agent delivery idempotent, recoverable, and observable before treating the umbrella issue as solved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the root CODEOWNERS owner and the recent merger of the config-mutation fix that already resolved one slice of this umbrella.
